comparators.input: old per-slot stored charge points and slot worth, handler slot count
comparators.output: for positive old charge with worth>1 retain quotient as physical count by extracting stored-minus-quotient; remainder stored in immutable PARTIAL_CHARGES map; empty map marks migration too
comparators.preservation: charge conservation: quotient*worth+remainder equals old points; skips empty/negative/denomination1 slots; component presence prevents repeat conversion
comparators.application_limit: getTotalCharge/useCharge consumers combine physical count and remainder. One migration chain, not one credit per slot or item subclass

comparators.input: entityTag full entity NBT, extraMobData, optional cached entity
comparators.output: resets cache on present saved tag, lazy recursive loader then type-only fallback; writer reserializes live entity or catches and retains old tag
comparators.preservation: Read complete class including components, saveEntityToTag, loadEntityFromTag and SavingItemHandler. Item capability mutation updates retained entityTag only for nonsimulated operations. Owned captured entity payload is independent of normal entity reader, not repeated basic ItemStack wrapper.
comparators.application_limit: Type-only fallback loses attributes/inventory; release addFreshEntity return ignored before removeEntity, so no guaranteed successful release. Empty/invalid entity may not recover; absent entityTag does not clear reused owner; no runtime proof.

comparators.input: Required entity_type/string, entity_data/CompoundTag, deployed_uuid/UUID; component absent→emptylist; NIL_UUID means stored, deployed actual entity UUID means receipt
comparators.output: Copies nested data on read/write, filters empty slots and clamps selected index. Capacity never below already-held count. Capture checks tamed owner or saddle, serializes entity minus UUID/Pos/Motion/Rotation then discards source. Decode invalid/missing type→null keeps payload; release updates receipt only if addFreshEntity returns true. Deployed recall queries live UUID before recapture; regeneration decodes/updates health then saves payload
comparators.preservation: One physical mount custody+deployed receipt owner, all species/slots/regeneration/interface fields support0; distinct native horse world persistence and blueprint template because item holds exclusive live entity custody. Stored entity retains gameplay properties but location/identity reset deliberately; do not generalize full entity NBT capture to player ForgeData.
comparators.application_limit: Codec all3fields required, legacy missing deployed_uuid does not automatically become NIL; full ItemStack component error policy unread. Malformed entity.load may throw; unloaded/wrongdimension deployed entity remains unresolved receipt without conjuring clone. catchHorse writes slot before discard but no success result from setHorseSlot; invalid index theoretically discards without storing, normal callers bound it. No whole client UI/template initial balancing review, no native runtime or death lifecycle proof. Borrowed entity ownership checks differ from player progression policy.

Null item id switch can throw; salmon size unconstrained generic value. Empty bucket_entity_data not cleaned. Native later component consumer not deep-read; no claim actual modern entity release tested. Only migration mechanics may inform minimal alias guard; no variant or asset changes.

proposals.mechanism: Legacy {entityTag:{id,...}} reads through OLD_CODEC; current shape separates entity_type and entity_tag. Actual component uses CODEC with alternative new/old formats. Record constructor strips lifetime identity/location fields including UUID, Brain, Pos, Motion, Rotation, id and leash; capture saveWithoutId then same constructor, so typed carrier stores selective concrete creature state. Old filled/empty item IDs alias to current vial. Actual capture copies one existing vial, stores Soul and maxHealth display, shrinks input then discards entity. Release reassembles fresh compound with current registered type id, attempts creation/add then consumes filled vial to fresh empty even if Optional creation empty. Same carrier can deliberately spend soul on spawner type change.
proposals.dedup: Ars6c46 already covers generic full captured-mob jar and fallback; Relicsf566 covers selective payload minus UUID and acknowledgement-controlled deployment, so those primitives alone add0. Proposed increment is concrete legacy inline-ID payload→separated registered type/payload format, constructor lifetime stripping applied to loaded legacy/current data, old item IDs converging to component owner, and the actual one-vial consumer on both release and spawner conversion. Requiembottledsoul f947 uses separate world soul-record UUID/deferred capture, not this creature snapshot schema. Paper bucketb98 concerns creature subtype item componentization, not generic full captured entity typed envelope. One chain only; codec helpers/UI/health/dispenser add0.
limits: Source comments say legacy keeps ID, but OLD_CODEC calls Soul(tag) which delegates to canonical constructor, and IGNORED_KEYS removes ID. Actual code governs; getEntityTagWithId reconstructs id on a copy.

NEW_CODEC validates nonnull type, OLD_CODEC parses inline id directly; malformed ResourceLocation can throw; unknown registry lookup fallback semantics not audited. OPTIONAL_CODEC uses a less strict new codec and EMPTY filtering, but actual persistent SOUL component uses CODEC, not OPTIONAL_CODEC.

Canonical record mutates supplied CompoundTag by removing ignored keys; no defensive copy there. Soul.copy explicitly copies; capture creates fresh tag. No proof arbitrary callers retain original input unmodified.
UUID intentionally stripped; released entity cannot be described as preserving original identity. Brain deliberately stripped too; selected payload only, not full state restoration.

Player release unconditionally runs consumed callback inside hasEntity branch after Optional create, even when creation empty or addFreshEntity fails. Filled vial can be spent without creature delivery; no exactly-once or acknowledged release guarantee.
Spawn uses EntityType.create, not recursive passenger loader in observed release. Passenger restoration not guaranteed even if nested passenger data remains.
Spawner conversion intentionally retains only entity type, consumes captured creature state; maximum health component used by tooltip, not authority to reset live health.

Dispenser handler registration and path read; SoulBoundUtils.isBound relies on external capability registration not expanded, so no blanket guarantee dispenser routing works for every Soul component holder.
Native component/codec runtime, remapping engine and game interaction not executed; no production patch inferred.

proposals.mechanism: Actual tear stores a full oversized single matching stack through shared component handler, not just displayed mode. Player/container extraction funds its count, matching pickups add then discard world item; outputs decrement actual accepted insertion, replenishment or successful placement. Mode controls reserve/refill, while encoded inventory is genuine owned material. Missing ENABLED component makes isEmpty true even with existing content; explicit empty cleanup removes contents and enabled.
proposals.dedup: Quarkf01 already covers single prototype/bulk count custody, real inventory transfers and planting debit. Reliquarye813 already owns shared oversized-container and charge migration chain. Modes/refill variants and another portable material holder insufficient independent increment; candidate getMode itself is only policy getter. Actual ownership evidence is useful support0 rather than a new case per item or mode.
limits: Modern shared disk slot codec stores oversized full stack components/count; stream uses native OPTIONAL_STREAM_CODEC, whose oversized-count behavior not audited. No native disk/network roundtrip claim.

VoidTear.isEmpty is based on presence of ENABLED, not boolean value; enabled=false is still nonempty, missing enabled with nonzero payload treated empty. Later build can overwrite retained contents; this is an invariant boundary.

Normal fillTear checks current count <=limit but consumes excess from player without clamping to remaining capacity, then directly sets enlarged count. World pickup path separately checks total<=limit. No observed universal capacity invariant.
Container extract helper passes maxToRemove on each loop instead of remaining; certain handlers can return beyond remaining budget. Static source observation only, not reproduced.
Placement constructs fresh ItemStack(itemBlock), so original nested block components may not be forwarded; consume only when place.consumesAction.
first matching refill uses stack getter mutable return; component handler writes on setters, outer player handler mutation semantics not audited. No universal IItemHandler reference-safety guarantee.
Creative initial build can create configured material count without extraction as an explicit upstream creative rule. No Dynasty gameplay changes authorized.

prior_hash_policy: Old receipts retain hashes of their original snapshots. Corrected02 receipt is a distinct new snapshot bound by03 correction record; no claim old digest authenticates new contents.
